제품 소개 페이지에는 ‘업계 최고 정확도’라는 문구가 크게 표시돼 있고, 고객이 10배 빠르게 의사결정한다는 표현도 실려 있다.[S1]

그러나 기능이 존재한다는 설명은 그 기능이 경쟁 제품보다 정확하다거나 모든 문서에서 오류 없이 작동한다는 증거와 같지 않다.[S1]

coverage.not_an_automatic_proof: Text span/quote/SHA/non-whitespace coverage checks are mechanical. Semantic completeness remains one reviewers self-assessment, not an automated proof or independent second review.

limitations: Single Astra judgment, not a scientific estimate of general accuracy or a model/condition comparison.
Only supplied source bodies ground factual truth; actual page layout, URL hosting, product performance and current fix deployment were not externally tested.
Atom counts include repeated mentions and depend on grouping, so are not independent statistical samples.
Clearly marked or contextually obvious judgments/inferences are separated; no error is invented merely because a sentence is inferential.
